mapper.select: SELECT biz13_with_corp_id AS with_corp_id , biz13_corp_id AS corp_id , biz13_manage_type AS manage_type , sys15_corp_cd AS corp_cd , sys15_corp_nm AS corp_nm , f_cdnm('ManageType', biz13_manage_type, biz13_company_id, f_today()) AS manage_type_nm FROM biz13_with_corp INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = biz13_corp_id WHERE sys15_corp_nm LIKE #{searchText} AND biz13_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY COALESCE(biz13_first_start_date, '9999-12-31')
